description: Refactor AI services to support direct OpenAI API calls when ANYTHING proxy is not configured. This covers: (1) the AI chat completion gateway, (2) image generation, and (3) the web scraping function in the orchestrator. The TTS module already has direct OpenAI fallback and needs no changes.
steps: Modify apps/web/src/app/api/utils/ai.ts - Add OpenAI direct fallback. When NEXT_PUBLIC_CREATE_BASE_URL and ANYTHING_PROJECT_TOKEN are not set but OPENAI_API_KEY is available, call https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions directly with model from env var OPENAI_MODEL (default 'gpt-4o'). Send messages array and response_format: { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { name: schema.name, strict: true, schema: schema.schema } } when jsonSchema is provided. Parse response from data.choices[0].message.content. Keep the existing proxy path as priority #1 (same pattern as TTS).

Modify apps/web/src/lib/assets/image-gen.ts - Add OpenAI direct fallback. When proxy is not configured but OPENAI_API_KEY is set, call https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations with model 'dall-e-3', prompt, size, and n:1. Parse response from data.data[0].url. Keep returning null on failure (graceful degradation).

Modify apps/web/src/lib/ugc/orchestrate.ts - Refactor scrapeProduct() function. When proxy is not configured, use a direct fetch approach: fetch the URL with a browser-like User-Agent header, get HTML text, strip tags to extract text content (simple regex), truncate to 4000 chars, then pass to chatCompletionJson for extraction (same as current). Remove the hard throw when proxy is not configured - instead check if OPENAI_API_KEY is available for the GPT extraction step.

Update existing tests in apps/web/src/lib/ugc/orchestrate.test.ts - The scrapeProduct tests check for 'Scraping service is not configured' error. Update these to test the new direct-fetch fallback behavior. Add test case for direct scraping when OPENAI_API_KEY is set but proxy vars are missing.

Add tests for the new OpenAI direct path in apps/web/src/app/api/utils/ai.test.ts - Test that chatCompletion calls OpenAI directly when proxy is not configured. Test that json_schema response_format is correctly formed. Test error handling.

Add tests for the new OpenAI direct path in apps/web/src/lib/assets/image-gen.test.ts - Test that generateImage calls OpenAI directly when proxy is not configured. Test graceful null return on failure.
acceptance_criteria: When OPENAI_API_KEY is set and proxy vars are NOT set, chatCompletion successfully calls OpenAI API directly
When OPENAI_API_KEY is set and proxy vars are NOT set, generateImage calls DALL-E 3 directly
When OPENAI_API_KEY is set and proxy vars are NOT set, scrapeProduct fetches the URL directly and uses GPT for extraction
When NEITHER proxy vars NOR OPENAI_API_KEY is set, all functions throw appropriate errors
When proxy vars ARE set, the proxy path is still used (backwards compatible)
All existing tests continue to pass
New tests cover the direct OpenAI paths
